description: Built and shipped customer-facing features using Next.js for a high-traffic e-commerce storefront.
Developed an order management API supporting 10+ filters with optimized queries for fast retrieval across 100K+ orders.
Built a flexible rule-based collection system supporting nested conditions across products, brands, pricing, and custom attributes.
Improved backend scalability by optimizing data-intensive queries and workflows handling 100K+ records.
[24 More](https://24more.in): Built the storefront end-to-end, owning its architecture and implementation.
Cut TBT, LCP and FCP by 30% with code-splitting, lazy loading and image work.
Added structured data to lift SEO.
Wrote Jest and RTL tests to keep components solid.
Polished the overall feel and flow.
Built a fast analytics dashboard in Next.js, tuned to render large datasets.
Wired in AI voice and text over WebSockets and REST.
Built modular, scalable UI for core banking flows in React and TypeScript.
Shaped solid data layers with strict types to cut runtime errors.
